baseline_scope: Boot-time selection of system configuration generations
SRQ_comparison: Inject activation interruption and verify actual selected generation after reboot
measured_outputs: Old-or-new complete generation; recovery-time distribution; retained-state hash
claim_boundary: Does not establish firmware integrity or hardware attestation

baseline_scope: Atomic filesystem-tree deployment and boot configuration transitions; exact upstream release tag must be recorded
SRQ_comparison: Use same power-cut points and incomplete-artifact cases where feasible
measured_outputs: Rollback success rate; time to known-good; artifact and generation digests
claim_boundary: Does not establish firmware integrity or hardware attestation; v2026.4 reopens GHSA-7cgc-gp99-6jmm for hostile static-delta input, so eligible corpus/scope must be explicit

baseline_scope: A/B or multi-version atomic updates for supported resource layouts; pin the stable source tag for the run
SRQ_comparison: Test prepare/activate interruption, network loss, and fallback selection
measured_outputs: Failure outcome per checkpoint; selected generation; offline recovery result
claim_boundary: Deployment layout and exact build must be recorded; tag choice alone does not imply qualification

baseline_scope: Signed update metadata and rollback/freeze/mix-and-match/key-compromise threat model; use tagged stable specification for frozen comparisons
SRQ_comparison: Reuse TUF test fixtures and verify platform target/policy/generation bindings around update decisions
measured_outputs: False accepts; false rejects; metadata error classification; verifier latency
claim_boundary: Do not replace or overclaim TUF metadata semantics; keep 1.0.37 working spec separate until tagged as a release

baseline_scope: Artifact build/source provenance and verifiable attestations
SRQ_comparison: Verify expected source/builder/build definition and separately attest deployed-generation observation
measured_outputs: Provenance verification result; source/build/check-out SHAs; deployed-generation digest
claim_boundary: Build provenance alone does not prove current runtime state

baseline_scope: Attester, Verifier, Relying Party roles and freshness policies
SRQ_comparison: Test challenge issuance, stale/replay rejection, and claim ceiling; hardware attestation remains its own tier
measured_outputs: Replay false accepts; challenge latency; trusted clock and evidence source identity
claim_boundary: Application freshness binding is not a complete RATS implementation

baseline_scope: TPM-rooted remote boot attestation and runtime integrity measurement
SRQ_comparison: Future optional hardware-attestation tier; never equate software receipts to TPM-backed results
measured_outputs: Attester identity, measured state, verifier policy, trust-anchor chain, hardware tuple

baseline_scope: Network configuration snapshot differential reachability and unintended flow-change analysis
SRQ_comparison: Use as pre-deployment network baseline, then test live effective-policy observation and challenge-bound promotion
measured_outputs: Reachability diffs; observed policy digest; freshness decision; promotion result
claim_boundary: Not a substitute for live traffic evidence or device identity

baseline_scope: Firmware protection, detection, and secure recovery guidelines
SRQ_comparison: Run only on identified hardware/firmware with a defined fault and recovery procedure
measured_outputs: Firmware tuple; fault class; detection/recovery outcome; trust-root evidence
claim_boundary: QEMU/OS generation tests do not qualify firmware resilience

SRQ_comparison: Map applicable controls to deployed NixOS profile and record justified exceptions
measured_outputs: Control coverage; exceptions; independent assessment results
claim_boundary: Control mapping is not an aggregate security guarantee

baseline_scope: Single-host durable policy promotion reference using SQLite WAL and synchronous=FULL; engine identity is pinned by source archive and sqlite_source_id()
SRQ_comparison: Run same target/challenge/generation conflicts and pre-/post-commit termination schedule against this reference and production adapter
measured_outputs: Decision/challenge counts; generation/policy binding; integrity_check; p50/p95/p99 commit and reopen latency
claim_boundary: Single-host SQL atomicity is not distributed locking, witness rollback resistance, kernel-crash, or power-loss qualification
